# Inline Bio Refs

## Crew

Captain: Corven Ashgrave, commanding from the quarterdeck.

Corven Ashgrave grew up on the docks of a forgotten port and has never
forgiven the Crown for razing his home village. He believes the sea
itself owes him a debt, and he trusts no one outside his hand-picked
crew — his only fear is dying before he can settle it.
